021import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
023
024import java.util.UUID;
025import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
026
027/**
028 * Represents a service for managing shop tags.
029 *
030 * <p>This service is responsible for:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>Normalizing and displaying tags</li>
033 *   <li>Persisting tags to the database</li>
034 *   <li>Removing tags from shops</li>
035 *   <li>Toggling system-defined tags</li>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * <p>Implementations are expected to connect directly to the database layer,
039 * while a tag manager handles in-memory indexing and caching.</p>
040 *
041 * @author creatorfromhell
042 * @since 6.3.0.0
043 */
044public interface TagService {
045
046  /**
047   * Represents the index key used for total counts in tag count maps.
048   *
049   * @since 6.3.0.0
050   */
051  long TOTAL_INDEX = -1L;
052
053  /**
054   * Represents the reserved system tag for favorites.
055   *
056   * @since 6.3.0.0
057   */
058  String SYS_FAV = "@fav";
059
060  /**
061   * Represents the reserved system tag for watch tracking.
062   *
063   * @since 6.3.0.0
064   */
065  String SYS_WATCH = "@watch";
066
067  /**
068   * Represents the reserved system tag for avoided shops.
069   *
070   * @since 6.3.0.0
071   */
072  String SYS_AVOID = "@avoid";
073
074  /**
075   * Generates a command based on the provided tag value and list mode.
076   *
077   * @param stored The tag value as a {@code String}. If {@code null}, the fallback "tag list" command is returned.
078   * @param list   A {@code boolean} indicating whether the command should be in list format or not.
079   *               If {@code true}, the method returns commands in the "list" format (e.g., "favorite list").
080   *               If {@code false}, it returns commands in single format (e.g., "favorite").
081   * @return A {@code String} representing the command based on the input {@code stored} and {@code list} values.
082   *         Possible outputs include:
083   *         - "tag list" if {@code stored} is {@code null}.
084   *         - "favorite", "watch", or "avoid" (and their respective list forms) for predefined system tags.
085   *         - "tag remove <stored>" for custom tags if {@code list} is {@code false}.
086   * @since 6.3.0.0
087   */
088  String commandFromTag(String stored, final boolean list);
089
090  /**
091   * Formats a stored tag for display to a player.
092   *
093   * <p>System tags are converted into friendly display names, while
094   * custom tags are prefixed with a hash character.</p>
095   *
096   * @param sender the player receiving the display value
097   * @param stored the stored tag value
098   *
099   * @return the formatted display value, or an empty string if the tag is null
100   *
101   * @since 6.3.0.0
102   */
103  String displayTag(Player sender, String stored);
104
105  /**
106   * Formats a stored tag for display while preserving system tags.
107   *
108   * <p>System tags beginning with {@code @} are returned unchanged,
109   * while custom tags are prefixed with a hash character.</p>
110   *
111   * @param stored the stored tag value
112   *
113   * @return the formatted tag, or an empty string if the tag is null
114   *
115   * @since 6.3.0.0
116   */
117  String displayTagOrHash(String stored);
118
119  /**
120   * Normalizes a tag into its stored form.
121   *
122   * <p>This includes trimming whitespace, lowercasing the value,
123   * removing a leading hash character, enforcing a maximum length, and validating allowed
124   * characters.</p>
125   *
126   * @param input       the input tag
127   * @param allowSystem whether reserved system tags are allowed
128   *
129   * @return the normalized tag, or {@code null} if invalid
130   *
131   * @since 6.3.0.0
132   */
133  @Nullable String normalizeTag(@Nullable String input, boolean allowSystem);
134
135  /**
136   * Adds a tag to a shop for a player.
137   *
138   * @param player the player applying the tag
139   * @param shopId the shop id
140   * @param tag    the tag to add
141   *
142   * @return a future containing {@code true} if the tag was added
143   *
144   * @since 6.3.0.0
145   */
146  CompletableFuture<Boolean> addShopTag(UUID player, long shopId, String tag);
147
148  /**
149   * Removes a tag from a shop for a player.
150   *
151   * @param player the player removing the tag
152   * @param shopId the shop id
153   * @param tag    the tag to remove
154   *
155   * @return a future containing {@code true} if the tag was removed
156   *
157   * @since 6.3.0.0
158   */
159  CompletableFuture<Boolean> removeShopTag(UUID player, long shopId, String tag);
160
161  /**
162   * Removes all tags from a shop.
163   *
164   * @param shopId the shop id
165   *
166   * @return a future containing {@code true} if tags were removed
167   *
168   * @since 6.3.0.0
169   */
170  CompletableFuture<Boolean> removeAllShopTags(long shopId);
171
172  /**
173   * Removes all tags applied by a specific player to a shop.
174   *
175   * @param shopId the shop id
176   * @param player the player whose tags should be removed
177   *
178   * @return a future containing {@code true} if tags were removed
179   *
180   * @since 6.3.0.0
181   */
182  CompletableFuture<Boolean> removeAllShopTagsBy(long shopId, UUID player);
183
184  /**
185   * Toggles a reserved system tag on a shop for a player.
186   *
187   * <p>If the tag does not exist it will be added. If it already exists
188   * it will be removed.</p>
189   *
190   * @param player the player toggling the tag
191   * @param shopId the shop id
192   * @param tag    the system tag
193   *
194   * @return a future containing {@code true} if the tag is enabled after the operation
195   *
196   * @since 6.3.0.0
197   */
198  CompletableFuture<Boolean> toggleSystemTag(UUID player, long shopId, String tag);
199}
